boundary: Manage work: coordination identities, child allocation, grants and receipt ownership
integrationGap: SessionService owns durable child allocations, authority, start outbox and reconciliation; it has no application/TaskOrchestrator consumer on this baseline. General unrelated-session controls and scoped holds remain unwired. S2/S5/S6 must consume and extend these owners, separating allocation from starting a model turn.

boundary: O7: shared orchestration policy and ordinary Symposium contributors
integrationGap: Consume exact identity, scope and admission contracts; a Symposium seat grant does not confer work-level coordination or access to unrelated transcripts. Shared role policy is not a second scheduler.

boundary: Work/artifacts: immutable retained documents, adopted references and progress
integrationGap: Retained bytes/revisions/provenance already exist. S3 must add exact original exchange selections and lossless DTO fields without rewriting retained artifacts. Include new relations in existing backup ownership.

boundary: Symposium and ordinary collaboration: reviewed context and attributed messages
integrationGap: Snapshot/join/delivery contracts exist, but public message/join/snapshot mutations currently return execution_unavailable. Reuse attribution/context semantics while preserving independent ordinary chats and explicit grants.

boundary: Runtime selection: trusted catalogs and unchanged ordinary settings
integrationGap: The pure resolver alone does not prove route readiness. Consume trusted configured capability, immutable session binding and ordinary control owners; retain unavailable selections and exact account/model/thinking/target/workspace across retries.

boundary: Execution backend: ordinary preparation, admission, FIFO and provider lifecycle
integrationGap: Resolve and prepare through existing route-specific owners. Session linkage/allocation is separate from queue admission, physical provider execution and verified completion; do not introduce a parallel runtime or launch path.
Existing promotion and execution trees must reconcile with the authoritative Telos parent tree. S2/S5 must recover partial cross-store writes and repeated promotion instead of creating another root.

boundary: Presentation: approved outcome workspace and the existing full ordinary chat
integrationGap: S7/S8 own frozen mock conformance and all actual user navigation. S1 fixtures do not prove chooser behavior, ordinary chat parity, mobile layout or back-state restoration.
S5 must dispatch only the selected item through an explicit ordinary conversation and recover the same attempt after uncertainty. Existing task completion is not verified parent-outcome completion.

boundary: Goal accounting: intent, execution, conversation and spend namespaces
integrationGap: Preserve Telos IDs, task execution IDs and ContexGin accounting goal IDs independently. Work linkage and chat allocation cannot create or relabel accounting spend or claim final tokens-to-goal.

boundary: Identity and data boundaries: user/grant enforcement and lossless canonical composition
integrationGap: Host authorization must enforce work/session relationships and reviewed context; role labels cannot mint grants. External Codex origins stay external and must never be inserted as ordinary Mitzo allocations.

boundary: Canonical Telos item, legacy provenance and parent-tree ownership
integrationGap: Existing DTO truncates source raw_snippet to 200 characters and omits authoritative dates. S2/S3 must expose existing original values, keep parent_id authoritative and preserve unknown kind/provenance without inventing an assignment.
